evidenceBoundary: Definitions apply to the repository's synthetic CRM and ERP sample data and are not approved enterprise targets.

kpis.businessQuestion: How much source-recorded sales value is in the selected scope?
kpis.definition: Sum of source sales_amount at sales-line grain.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Respects report filters and country RLS; retains blank order dates outside Date-filtered selections.
kpis.limitations: Currency is not defined. Values are synthetic reference results.

kpis.definition: Count of nonblank distinct order numbers.
kpis.limitations: Order number is not a sales-line key and must not be used to count fact rows.

kpis.definition: Sum of source quantity at sales-line grain.
kpis.limitations: Synthetic reference data; quantity validity is assessed separately.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is average sales value per represented order?
kpis.definition: Total Sales divided by Distinct Orders.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when no orders are present.
kpis.limitations: Not a customer lifetime or invoice-value metric.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many distinct purchasing customers are represented?
kpis.definition: Count of nonblank distinct customer IDs in Sales.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes blank customer IDs and respects RLS.
kpis.limitations: Does not mean all registered customers.

kpis.businessQuestion: What effective-dated master-cost amount is associated with sold units?
kpis.definition: Quantity multiplied by the Product master cost effective on the order date, summed across lines.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Uses the Gold Product surrogate key resolved from order date and Product validity interval.
kpis.limitations: Estimate only: effective-dated master cost is not an accounting posting and excludes freight, discounts, returns, tax, and allocations.

kpis.businessQuestion: What sales value remains after effective-dated master-cost estimate?
kpis.limitations: Not accounting gross profit; always label Estimated.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of sales remains after effective-dated master-cost estimate?
kpis.definition: Estimated Gross Profit divided by Total Sales.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when sales is zero or blank.
kpis.limitations: Not accounting margin; missing Product costs are represented as zero and must remain visible in DQ reporting.

kpis.businessQuestion: What was sales in the equivalent prior-year date context?
kpis.definition: Total Sales shifted one year through the explicit Date table.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Requires a valid contiguous Date table selection.
kpis.limitations: Returns blank where no comparable prior period exists.

kpis.businessQuestion: How did sales change against the equivalent prior-year period?
kpis.definition: Difference between Total Sales and Sales Previous Year divided by Sales Previous Year.
kpis.formula: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Sales Previous Year]) && [Sales Previous Year] <> 0, DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales Previous Year], [Sales Previous Year]))
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank, not zero, when the prior baseline is missing or zero.
kpis.limitations: No seasonal adjustment or target comparison.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of eligible orders shipped by their earliest due date?
kpis.definition: Orders whose latest ship date is on or before their earliest due date divided by eligible orders.
kpis.formula: Order-grain FILTER over VALUES(Sales[order_number]) with MAX(ship_date) <= MIN(due_date)
kpis.dateContext: Order date unless a dedicated inactive relationship measure is used
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes orders with blank ship or due date.
kpis.limitations: Conservative order-level definition; does not represent delivery confirmation.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many source sales lines have an invalid or blank order date?
kpis.definition: Count of Sales rows whose safe converted order date is blank.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Can be hidden by Date slicers; validate on the unfiltered Data Quality page.
kpis.limitations: A blank does not identify the original malformed value after safe conversion.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many evaluated checks currently have failed rows?
kpis.definition: Count of globally materialized refresh-time checks whose status is Failed.
kpis.formula: COUNTROWS(FILTER('Data Quality Checks', 'Data Quality Checks'[IsEvaluated] = TRUE() && 'Data Quality Checks'[Status] = "Failed"))
kpis.limitations: Not a production quality score; some source-to-Gold reconciliation remains unavailable.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of evaluated checks has zero failed rows?
kpis.definition: Average binary pass rate across globally materialized evaluated checks.
kpis.formula: AVERAGEX(FILTER('Data Quality Checks', 'Data Quality Checks'[IsEvaluated] = TRUE()), 'Data Quality Checks'[PassRate])
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Check-weighted; unevaluated checks are excluded and shown separately.
kpis.limitations: A zero evaluated count returns blank, never 100%.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many units are available in the selected inventory snapshot scope?
kpis.definition: Sum of on-hand quantity less reserved quantity at snapshot, warehouse, and Product-version grain.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Must be filtered to an intentional snapshot date or period; summing multiple snapshots is not an ending balance.
kpis.limitations: Semi-additive over time and based on synthetic reference snapshots.

kpis.businessQuestion: What effective-dated master-cost value is associated with the selected inventory snapshot scope?
kpis.definition: Sum of available quantity multiplied by mapped Product cost at snapshot line grain.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Must be filtered to an intentional snapshot date or period; uses the mapped curated Product cost.
kpis.limitations: Not an accounting inventory valuation and semi-additive over time.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many snapshot lines are at or below their reorder point?
kpis.definition: Count of Inventory snapshot lines whose available quantity is less than or equal to the recorded reorder point.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Counts lines, not distinct Products; respects Product, warehouse, and snapshot filters.
kpis.limitations: A repeated Product across warehouses or snapshot dates can contribute multiple lines.
